entry: 2026-09-12 — Mock surface and LLM config — accs correction

verification.summary: Implemented pnpm classify (classifier.ts, classificationsStore.ts, classificationComment.ts, classifierConfig.ts, llmClassifier.ts, classifyMain.ts) with jsonl upsert under $GENERATED_DIR/<specId>/, marker-based comment detection, and env-driven LLM config defaulted in .env.robots/.env.example. The first classify pass works end-to-end (all 20 issues CLASSIFIED, comments verified against jsonl), but the ACCS fails on its second pass: after 'stop_mock'/'start_mock', issue 1 comes back SKIPPED instead of REPOSTED, meaning the mock's in-memory comment survived the restart.

mustFix.problem: MOCK_PID is the pnpm wrapper's PID (from 'pnpm run mock-github &'), not the underlying tsx/node server; killing it can leave the actual mock-github process running and holding the port, so the second start_mock's readiness curl just talks to the still-alive first instance. That means the in-memory comment state never actually resets, so REPOSTED is unreachable for at least one issue and the ACCS fails deterministically regardless of classifier correctness.

findings.problem: MOCK_PID is the pnpm wrapper's PID (from 'pnpm run mock-github &'), not the underlying tsx/node server; killing it can leave the actual mock-github process running and holding the port, so the second start_mock's readiness curl just talks to the still-alive first instance. That means the in-memory comment state never actually resets, so REPOSTED is unreachable for at least one issue and the ACCS fails deterministically regardless of classifier correctness.

application.blocked: The ACCS's mock-restart step (specs/003-issues-classifier/output/accs.bash, stop_mock/start_mock) does not reliably kill the mock-github child process, so the mock's in-memory comments survive across the 'restart', causing the second classify pass to see issue 1 as already-commented (SKIPPED) instead of memory-lost (REPOSTED). This conflicts with the spec's replay requirement, which assumes a real memory loss on mock restart.
